text:
mike: heads up — noticed weird type collapse when our SDK is imported from an ESM edge function (Vercel). generics on overloaded functions become `any` after publish.
rachel: can you paste a tiny repro? sounds similar to prior issues but might be different.
mike: simplified SDK shape:

```ts
// src/api.ts
export function fetchThing<T = { id: string }>(id: string): Promise<T>;
export function fetchThing(id: string) {
  return Promise.resolve({ id });
}
```

consumer (ESM edge):

```ts
import { fetchThing } from 'redwood-inference-sdk';
const thing = await fetchThing('x');
// thing is inferred as any | Promise<any> in user code after install
```

mike: locally `tsc` shows Promise<{id: string}>, but after publish (tsup -> esm+cjs + dts bundling) consumers see `any`.

dev-bot: CI note: `packages/sdk/esm-build` job reported: "warning: collapsed overload signatures to single signature" from dts plugin.

lee: I replicated. The problem seems to be tsup's dts bundler combining overloads into a single signature with broad `any` fallback. bundlers that emit a combined declaration often drop generic defaults.

tara: alternative causes: package.json `types`/`exports` mispointing, or our rollup/tsup config rewriting paths. but the dts plugin is suspect.

mike: attempted fixes tried so far: bump TS to 5.2, set `declaration: true`, run `tsc` before tsup and copy `types` folder — none fixed the published package consumers get.
rachel: Did you check `.npmignore` or files included in the package? maybe dist/types are not shipped. run `npm pack` locally and inspect package contents.

mike: good call — `npm pack` shows `dist/index.d.ts` only (the bundled one). no per-file d.ts.

lee: Proposed fixes we discussed: 
- emit raw `.d.ts` per-file (turn off dts bundling in tsup or use `tsc --emitDeclarationOnly` into dist/types)
- add a handwritten `index.d.ts` that preserves overload declarations and re-exports impls (manual but safe)
- change API surface to remove overloads (breaking)

tara: I'd vote for `tsc --emitDeclarationOnly` in our build pipeline. It's explicit, predictable, and matches what consumers expect (unbundled definitions). Slightly bigger tarball but trivial.

dev-bot: action created: #4197 "Produce per-file .d.ts (emitDeclarationOnly) for SDK package" assigned to lee.

lee: I'll prototype switching the package build: `tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist/types` then run tsup for JS only. will update package.json `types` to `dist/types/index.d.ts` and add `files`/`publishConfig` checks.

mike: also add a small example in `examples/edge-types-smoke` that is ESM-first: run `pnpm -w`, `pnpm i` and `tsc --noEmit` in CI matrix with Node 20 and Vercel's bundler settings (vite/webpack fallback). should catch regressions.

rachel: add note in our SDK docs: "If you consume from an ESM edge runtime, ensure your bundler picks up package types; we publish unbundled d.ts. If you still see inference drop, try `moduleResolution: 'bundler'` vs `'node16'` — both can behave differently."

lee: PR opened (#4199) with a demo and CI smoke test. dev-bot: PR created and CI started.

mike: thanks — if PR passes I'll validate on a private Vercel project and report any other oddities (Cloudflare workers might have different resolution semantics).

rachel: tiny follow-up: also check `typesVersions` in package.json if we need an entrypoint variant for older TS consumers. not necessary for now but can help.

mike: noted. I'll post results once validated. :pray:
